outline:
本課程在使學生瞭解行銷管理的概念與理論，建立行銷管理以增加
市場優勢。課程主要內容包括：行銷思想、行銷策略、行銷元素、
總體行銷與電商行銷。
The objective of the course is to establish concepts and theory of
Marketing Management . Topics are as follows: Marketing Thought, Marketing Strategy, Marketing Elements, Macro Marketing and Online.
